archive_scope_boundary: The intake receipt covers the source, implementation, configuration, documentation, and selected historical-data roots recorded in that receipt. Unhashed operator caches, virtual environments, and volatile execution outputs are not evidence of source admission and remain excluded from this register.

status_semantics.admitted: Allowed only in the declared successor scope and under all listed policy boundaries.
status_semantics.candidate: Observed but not allowed in runtime, public release, or benchmark claims.
status_semantics.quarantined: Blocked pending a security, privacy, or manual-review disposition.
status_semantics.rejected: Retained only as historical inventory, never a source-data input.

records.reproducibility: hash-bound raw JSON inventory to immutable 16 MiB-or-smaller JSONL shards
prohibitions: Canadian field calibration or field-condition authority

records.admission_scope: failure-mode review and separately authored successor-case harvesting only
records.rights_basis: local historical proxy; upstream benchmark provenance and reuse rights not established
prohibitions: evaluation-suite import without duplicate, split, and licence review

records.admission_scope: source-specific rights, privacy, attribution, and redistributability review required
records.rights_basis: unknown until each upstream source is reviewed
records.reproducibility: archive hash alone is not redistribution permission

records.admission_scope: optional hash-bound install pack after source, portability, and field-boundary review
records.reproducibility: raw and derived spatial artifacts remain external install-pack candidates

records.admission_scope: manual security and fixture review only
records.reproducibility: intake path and hash retained without contents in this register
